name: P4 Behavioral Model (bmv2)
description: The reference P4 software switch. Takes JSON from P4 compiler and interprets it to implement packet-processing behavior. Includes simple_switch, simple_switch_grpc, and psa_switch targets.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Official Docker image p4lang/behavioral-model on Docker Hub. Multiple Dockerfiles: Dockerfile and Dockerfile.noPI. Community image cslev/p4-bmv2-docker also available.

eval_notes: Reference P4 switch for developing and testing P4 data planes. Not production-grade but essential for P4 development and education. Docker images enable quick lab setup for programmable data plane testing.
